query:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN phone LIKE '%-%' THEN 'has_hyphen'
    WHEN phone LIKE '+%' THEN 'has_plus'
    ELSE 'digits_only'
  END as format_type,
  COUNT(*) as cnt,
  MIN(phone) as sample_min,
  MAX(phone) as sample_max
FROM players
GROUP BY format_type;
